import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
print(w.work_id.nunique(), w.year.isna().sum())
y='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']).copy()
w['late']=w.year>=1876
w['r']=w[y]/w.n_passages
g=w.groupby(['genre','late']).agg(n=('r','size'),m=('r','mean')).unstack();print(g)
def est(d):
  t=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (t[True]-t[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high']:
  print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('origin');
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
w2=w[(w.year<1866)|(w.year>=1886)];print('gap',est(w2))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
"
